titulo_es: Use the congiuntive according to the main verb

temere.consejo: Word of feeling that governs congiuntive.

purché.es: con tal de que; siempre que
purché.consejo: Conditional conjunction that governs compulsory congiuntive.

texto: **Verbos de pensamiento u opinión**: credere, pensare, ritenere (**Ritengo che sia opportuno**).
**Verbos de voluntad y deseo**: fly, desiderare, prefer (**Voglio che tu ascolti**).
**Verbos de sentimiento y temor**: temere, avere paura che (**Temo che piova**).
**Conjunciones subordinantes**: benzé, affinche, purché, prima che (**Purché tu sia d'accordo**).

filas: Credo che il treno sia già arrivato.
Temo che la riunione duri troppo.
Preferisco che parli tu per primo.
Vengo volentieri, purché ci sia posto.

frases.it: Temo che la riunione duri più del previsto.
frases.es: Temo que la reunión dure más de lo previsto.
frases.en: I fear that the meeting will last longer than expected.
analisis: I'm afraid the meeting will last.

frases.it: È opportuno che prepariamo una sintesi scritta per il direttore.
frases.es: Es oportuno que preparemos una síntesis escrita para el director.
frases.en: It is appropriate that we prepare a written synthesis for the director.
analisis: It is appropriate that we prepare

frases.it: Vorrei che tu esponessi i punti principali della proposta.
frases.es: Quisiera que tú expusieras los puntos principales de la propuesta.
frases.en: I would like you to set out the main points of the proposal.
analisis: I'd like you to show up.
the main points of the proposal

frases.it: Va bene, accetto volentieri purché il responsabile sia d'accordo.
frases.es: Está bien, acepto con gusto siempre que el responsable esté de acuerdo.
frases.en: All right, I'll be happy to agree as long as the person responsible agrees.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal mode does the «purché» conjunction always require (as long as)?

opciones.explicacion: «Purché» establishes a strict hypothetical condition and never admits indicative.
The future cannot be led by modal connectors like «purché».
The imperative is not subordinated by subordinate conjunctions.

bloques.frase: Temo che la riunione di lavoro ___ fino a tardi stasera.

opciones.explicacion: Congiuntive present of the verb «durare» with -i (-are → -i) termination.
This is an indication of the present: a fact that has been found with certainty.

bloques.frase: Purché il responsabile sia d'accordo con la nostra proposta.

opciones.texto: It establishes an essential requirement or condition for the implementation of the plan.
opciones.explicacion: It is equivalent to «as long as» or «provided that» the boss approves.

opciones.texto: It indicates a past cause that has already been completely resolved.
opciones.explicacion: It is not a historical cause but a future condition.

opciones.texto: It expresses a total opposition that invalidates any agreement.
opciones.explicacion: It does not reject the plan, only makes its acceptance conditional on one condition.

bloques.frase: Accetto la proposta purché tutti siano d'accordo
bloques.traduccion: I accept the proposal as long as everyone agrees

opciones.texto: Because it expresses a subjective apprehension or emotion in the face of an uncertain fact.
opciones.explicacion: The verbs of affectivity and fear induce congiuntive in the subordinate.

opciones.texto: Because it exactly amounts to the verb «sapere» of certainty.
opciones.explicacion: «Sapere» affirms objective certainty, all the opposite of «temere»'s fear.

opciones.texto: Because it's only used in indirect questions.
opciones.explicacion: It usually works in affirmative declarative prayers.

bloques.frase: È opportuno che voi ___ subito una relazione chiara dell'evento.

opciones.explicacion: Second plural person of congiuntive with regular deinence -iate.
It is present as an indication: «vosotros preparáis».
It's a simple future of indication.

bloques.pregunta: What does the speaker manifest in this prayer?
bloques.frase: Temo che piova durante la cerimonia all'aperto.

opciones.texto: Inquietude or suspicion of the probability of rain during the act.
opciones.explicacion: The congiuntive «piova» reflects the distressing uncertainty of the speaker.

opciones.texto: Absolute certainty that the rain prevented the wedding yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: It is a concern about the present or immediate future.

opciones.texto: I was glad to be enthusiastic because time is fully sunny.
opciones.explicacion: «Temere» denotes disgust or fear of the possibility of rain.

intro: The presence of the congiuntive in the subordinate phrase is almost always determined by the verb of the main prayer: if it expresses subjectivity, desire, fear or necessity, the congiuntive is activated.
